cohort: 2478 multiparous participants of at least 28 weeks of pregnancy at a university hospital in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
finding: Previous cesarean delivery was not a risk factor for severe maternal outcomes or adverse perinatal outcomes and was associated with a decreased risk of stillbirth, intrapartum stillbirth, and neonatal distress.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was associated with a decreased risk of stillbirth, intrapartum stillbirth, and neonatal distress.
